title: EventBookingPrivateFactsDocument
description: Server-only admission facts for one Catch booking, at eventBookingPrivateFacts/{eventId}_{uid} (the booking's own id). A booking cohort encodes the guest's gender and who they are interested in, which is their sexual orientation. Organisers read eventBookings and eventWaitlistOffers, so no cohort is stored there (#2493). The seat counters still need the exact cohort a booking was counted under and the one a waitlist offer reserves, so both are kept here. No client and no organiser reads it.
x-owner: booking, waitlist, offer and cancellation callables, in the booking's transaction

cohortAtSignup.description: The cohort the booking was counted under in the event's cohortCounts or waitlistedCohortCounts.

cohortAtOffer.description: The cohort the guest's live waitlist offer reserves.
